visuals.heading: Route Has Two Hard Filters, Not One

items.text: The second filter is cost and placement.

supporting: The first filter is the entrance exam. CAT 2025 had about 2.95 lakh registrations, down from 3.29 lakh a year earlier, according to Careers360. The five-year integrated route is smaller still: IIM Indore offers about 150 seats and IIM Rohtak about 198, per the Cracku IPMAT eligibility guide.

The second filter is cost and placement. A two-year IIM MBA is listed at about Rs 17 lakh to Rs 27.5 lakh in total fees depending on the campus, from the Careers360 IIM fee comparison updated in March 2026, and lower-ranked colleges may charge a lot without matching placement.

blocks.heading: What BBA Pay Looks Like in India

figures.label: Typical Salary Range
figures.source: General research shows one wide range, not one number. Careers360 puts BBA graduate pay at about Rs 1.8 lakh to Rs 6.1 lakh a year, based on its page updated 11 August 2026, with fresher monthly pay around Rs 20,000 to Rs 25,000.

blocks.heading: Check Before You Commit

items.text: Can your family carry three or four years of fees, a low-paid internship stretch and maybe a two-year MBA?

supporting: Can your family carry three or four years of fees, a low-paid internship stretch and maybe a two-year MBA? An IIM MBA alone is listed at about Rs 17 lakh to Rs 27.5 lakh in total fees. If money is tight, a lower-fee recognised degree with a paid skill on top can beat a costly BBA with no proof.

figures.label: Education Budget Amount
figures.source: An illustration, not a real fee: if the full education budget is Rs 10 lakh, a tenth is Rs 1 lakh for the BBA and a fifth, Rs 2 lakh, is the caution line. The remaining money should still pay for a laptop, internet, Excel and SQL practice, a reserve for slow months, and a skill you add after the degree.

items.text: Marketing that is measured by results, including performance and analytics work
Work inside global capability centres (India offices that big firms run for global work), up from 8% to 11% of fresher hiring
Your own service or business, backed by a paid skill

blocks.heading: What AI Is Cutting in BBA Jobs

items.text: Use AI to draft outreach, summarise research and speed up spreadsheet work
Check every number and claim it gives you before you send it
Keep a short record of what you improved with it, and by how much
Protect customer and company data, and do not paste private files into public tools
